title: Bi-Monthly Soda Firing
source_quote: Spend a Sunday with us learning soda firing (this will be a wood/soda firing) from the ground up. We start at 8am glazing, attaching wadding, and loading the soda kiln, watch it climb to temperature into the evening, then come back the next day at 6pm for the big reveal as we unload. Bring your own
